author: marthomahew
name: chants
short: Auto-reply to chant acronyms like FTP.
description: When someone types FTP, FTB, FTL, FTR or FSP anywhere in a message, the bot replies with the full chant (FTP → Fuck the Packers). Up to 3 replies per channel per minute. Admins can add or remove chants from Discord.
install_msg: Loaded? Try typing FTP. `[p]chant list` shows all chants; admins can `[p]chant add FTG Fuck the Giants`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
